status_note: All six projections (unwritten-input initialization incl. the spacebase ~0xff alignment, INT_AND convergence + COPY chain, PIECE concatenation, the sc6 y/64 INT_DIV/INT_REM shapes, and the MULTIEQUAL loop-clip phase-2 fixed points for both an OR-loop and an AND-loop) are byte-identical MATCH against the locked 12.0.4 oracle. FUNCDATA-CALCNZM-0002 consolidated (commit 65a2492): the complete getNZMaskLocal switch now lives in PcodeOp::get_nz_mask_local (src/op.rs, pinned via base_op_blob) and Funcdata::calc_nz_mask calls it directly; the funcdata.rs staged copy is deleted. This re-run pins base 65a2492 and is a value-equivalent pure move, so all observations are unchanged. Outside-fixture residual stays registered: varnode.rs Varnode::get_nz_mask still returns the pre-wiring conservative approximation instead of the varnode.hh:231 field read (FUNCDATA-CALCNZM-0003).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: calcNZMask(void) mutates Varnode::nzm in place through the shared Varnode objects; getNZMaskLocal(bool cliploop) is const, reads output/inrefs/parent only. Rugra mirrors with outvn.write().nzm assignments and the read-only PcodeOp method PcodeOp::get_nz_mask_local (src/op.rs, FUNCDATA-CALCNZM-0002 consolidation).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: phase 1 iterates beginOpAlive..endOpAlive (== obank alive order, mirrored by alivelist.clone()), inner DFS advances slot 0..numInput and pops when slot >= numInput; MULTIEQUAL looping edges are clipped via parent->isLoopIn(slot) in both phase 1 and the cliploop getNZMaskLocal arm; phase 2 seeds every MULTIEQUAL in alive order, pops from the back, and re-pushes vn->beginDescend() order descendants on change. Rugra mirrors each order exactly.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: no counters; nzm is a value state where phase 2 rewrites only when nzmask != vn->nzm; INT_MULT derives w1/w2/total bit widths from mostsig/leastsigbit_set of the input masks with the sa >= 8*size zero guard. Rugra mirrors both.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: no sorted containers anywhere in calcNZMask/getNZMaskLocal; the only comparisons are mask equality/inequality and the != fullmask / != 0 short-circuits in the OR/AND/ADD arms. Rugra mirrors.

cases.description: phase-1 unwritten-input initialization (funcdata_varnode.cc:887-896): constant nzm=offset (0x3f0), unwritten register input nzm=calc_mask(4)=0xffffffff, spacebase input nzm=calc_mask(8)&~0xff=0xffffffffffffff00 with sbflag=1 (marked by Funcdata::spacebase), plus COPY propagation of all three masks (op.cc:577-580)
INT_AND mask convergence (op.cc:590-594): EDI&0x3f0 -> 0x3f0, propagated unchanged through a two-deep COPY chain (phase-1 DFS post-order assigns the AND output before the copies pop)
PIECE concatenation (op.cc:693-698): hi mask 0x1122 shifted up by the 2-byte low input size OR lo mask 0x3344 -> 0x11223344

sc6 shapes: y1=EDI&0xffff=0xffff; d64=y1/64=coveringmask(0xffff)>>mostsigbit_set(64)=0x3ff; dfull=EDI/64=0x3ffffff; dodd=EDI/3=0x7fffffff; dvar=EDI/ESI (non-const denom, no shift term)=0xffffffff; rem=EDI%0x100=coveringmask(0xff)=0xff (op.cc:648-663)

MULTIEQUAL loop clipping + phase-2 worklist: phi(const 0xffff, INT_LEFT(phi,8)) in a self-loop block (addLoopEdge) prints isLoopIn=0,1; clipped phase-1 starts at 0xffff then phase-2 (getNZMaskLocal(false)) converges phi=0xffffffff shift=0xffffff00

clip precision observable: phi(const 0xff00, phi&0xf0f0) converges clipped to (0xff00,0xf000) with the loop-edge label vs (0xfff0,0xf0f0) for the identical unlabeled graph — clipping starts phase 2 from a lower seed and INT_AND prunes to a strictly tighter fixed point

residual_union.detail: varnode.rs Varnode::get_nz_mask (varnode.rs:1466) returns a conservative approximation (constants -> offset, others -> calc_mask(size)) instead of the varnode.hh:231 raw field read; its doc comment wrongly attributes nzm maintenance to Heritage/Cover (it is calcNZMask). Callers outside calc_nz_mask still observe the approximation; requires a varnode.rs lease.
